title.purpose: Caption heading per state on phone.

annotation.purpose: DOM labels in the first-person view; count at 30px in red.

label.purpose: Status lines, replay note, footer; tabular figures.

button.purpose: Back link and keyboard skip buttons.

materials3d.faceShader: emissive map holds bare melamine at board colour (smoothstep .55-.85), emissiveIntensity .5, roughness .36

lighting.shadowSwitch: faces receive shadows only lying flat (|cos θ| < .5); board core and frame cast only upright

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Drills sheet sliding over the board.

shadows.name: flat-page
shadows.purpose: Board images in the no-WebGL fallback.

shadows.name: caption-fade
shadows.value: linear-gradient(to top, #e3e7e8 calc(100% - 26px), rgba(227,231,232,0)); desktop to left, 80%

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: Drills sheet slide (0.7s) and hint nudge (1.8s loop, 12px).

motion.name: ease-board
motion.purpose: Board turns and camera moves.

motion.name: ease-arrive
motion.purpose: Magnets, walls, figures rising; caption fade-in; intro ease-in.

motion.name: turn
motion.purpose: Board turns over to a new angle.

motion.name: camera-same-page
motion.purpose: Camera move between states of the same page and camera type.

motion.name: camera-move
motion.purpose: Camera move between views on the same angle.

motion.name: draw-start
motion.purpose: When marker writing begins inside a transition.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Whole page written from recorded ops; stroke L/650s (0.05-0.4s), dash L/900s (0.05-0.28s), text 0.03s/char (0.08-0.4s), fill 0.16s; each op starts at 45% of the previous.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Magnets land, walls and CT/T figures rise after the writing.

motion.name: collapse
motion.purpose: Leaving props shrink.

motion.name: caption-out
motion.purpose: Outgoing caption fades at transition start.

motion.name: caption-in
motion.purpose: Caption fades in last.

motion.name: intro
motion.value: 2.2s ease-in, title writes from 0.6s; hint after 2s, fade 0.5s
motion.purpose: First load.

motion.name: ego-flick
motion.purpose: Crosshair travels the preaim angle onto the head; count runs to 0,0°.

motion.name: flash-whiteout
motion.purpose: Flash page white-out with instruction.

motion.name: he
motion.value: boom 0.08s up / 0.22s down, ring 0.6s, soot 1.6s, shake 0.45s
motion.purpose: HE page.

motion.name: molotov
motion.value: flames spread 0.5s, flee path 0.4s, CT runs 1.1s
motion.purpose: Molotov page.

motion.name: smoke
motion.purpose: Smoke page.

motion.name: wheel-quiet
motion.purpose: Wheel locks after a step until this quiet gap; delta threshold 40; ignored during transitions.

motion.name: swipe
motion.purpose: Touch and key input queue one step.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: no turns, camera moves, writing, intro, flick, nudge, white-out or sheet slide; pages and props appear complete; grenade pages show end state
fallbacks.noWebGL: scrolling page of flat board canvases drawn complete (positions as marker rings), captions below each, drills inline

constraints: Maps are labelled sketches (Skizze); positions are not measured.
Only the owner's stats and lobby averages; no other players' names or Steam IDs.
No Valve assets; figures are original CT/T-style models.
Leetify attribution: "Data Provided by Leetify" and "View on Leetify" link.

components.css: :root{--room:#e3e7e8;--board:#f2f4f3;--ink:#1c1e23;--ink-2:#444952;--blue:#1f4fbf;--red:#d62f2a;--red-text:#b5221d;--hand:"Permanent Marker","Marker Felt","Segoe Print","Bradley Hand",cursive;--sans:"Archivo","Helvetica Neue","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);}.ds-cap{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:34px 22px 26px;background:linear-gradient(to top,var(--room,#e3e7e8) calc(100% - 26px),rgba(227,231,232,0));font:16px/1.5 var(--sans,Archivo,sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#1c1e23)}.ds-cap h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--hand,"Permanent Marker",cursive);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(22px,6vw,30px);line-height:1.12;max-width:22ch;text-wrap:balance}.ds-cap p{margin:0;color:var(--ink-2,#444952);max-width:48ch}.ds-cap b{color:var(--ink,#1c1e23)}.ds-fix{color:var(--red-text,#b5221d)!important;font-weight:700}.ds-lobby{color:var(--blue,#1f4fbf);font-weight:600}

narrative.overview:
The whole page is one physical object: a double-sided white melamine whiteboard in an aluminium frame on a rolling stand with a marker tray, lit by bright, even room light in a pale grey room. There is no scrolling document and no chrome. Each gesture turns the board to its next page, the new face is written stroke by stroke in dry-erase marker, magnets land, walls and original CT/T figures rise, and only then does the caption appear. Lessons are drawn, explained and wiped; faint eraser ghosting of the previous page stays on the surface.

Three marker inks carry all meaning: black for structure, blue dashed for the lobby, red for the player's own number that has to move. Two voices write on it: a marker hand (Permanent Marker) for everything written on the board, captions and the one giant number per chapter, and a sturdy grotesk (Archivo) for reading text and small print. Density is low: one lesson, one number, one sketch per page.

The system rejects the dark stats dashboard of KPI tiles and neon charts. Every mark encodes a measured value of the owner against their own lobbies; illustrations never pretend to be data, so every map is labelled a sketch.
keyCharacteristics: One pivoting whiteboard, paged one gesture at a time; the page itself never scrolls.
A fixed transition sequence: turn or camera move, marker writing, magnets and figures, caption last.
Three-ink grammar: black structure, blue dashed lobby, red for the player's value to fix.
Data marks are marker marks (tallies, hatched boxes, checks and crosses, rings, arrows), never painted dots.
Portrait board on phones, landscape board on desktop; caption below or beside.
Same facts survive without motion and without WebGL.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Black is structure, blue dashed is the lobby, red is the player's own value that has to move. A colour never changes meaning between pages.

rules.name: The Lobby Is Blue Rule
rules.body: Every lobby value, on the board or in a caption, is Lobby Blue; every comparison is the player against their own lobbies, never pros or global averages.

rules.name: The Orange Is You Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only as the magnet under the player's figure. Graphite marks the CT opponent, tan a teammate.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Marker hand for what is written on the board and its headings; Archivo for anything read as a sentence. No third family.

rules.name: The One Giant Number Rule
rules.body: Each data chapter carries exactly one giant marker number, the player's value, in Fix Red.

rules.name: The Lying Flat Rule
rules.body: Faces receive shadows only while lying flat; upright, the board is lit evenly so marker writing never carries a shadow band.

dos: Do move exactly one page per gesture, and keep the order: turn or camera move, marker writing, magnets and figures, caption last.
Do encode every value as a marker mark (stroke, dashed line, tally, hatched box, check, cross, ring, arrow) in the three inks.
Do write "Skizze" on every map page; positions are illustrative and not measured.
Do keep all map writing at the board's near edge on phone so side cameras stay clean.
Do compare only the owner's stats with lobby averages, and keep "Data Provided by Leetify" with the "View on Leetify" link.
Do give every effect page its own caption with the data, and let a tap or click replay it.
Do keep the same facts reachable with reduced motion and without WebGL.
donts: Don't turn the debrief into a dark stats dashboard of KPI tiles and neon charts.
Don't use painted dots as data marks on the board; 3D magnets belong under figures only.
Don't use red for lobby values or blue for the player; colours never change meaning.
Don't show other players' names or Steam IDs.
Don't use or redistribute Valve assets (character models, maps, logos); figures are original CT/T-style models and maps are labelled sketches.
Don't add top bars, menus or start buttons; the board and the swipe hint carry the page.
